rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments of Dr. Goyal and Prof. Varma regarding the moderation of core inflation to 3.60%, I remain concerned that shifting to a neutral stance at this juncture would be premature. The headline CPI at 5.10% remains significantly above our 4.00% target, and the persistent food inflation of 8.30% continues to exert pressure on household budgets, particularly in rural areas. Given the positive output gap of 0.50% and the current liquidity conditions, maintaining the stance of withdrawal of accommodation is essential to ensure that inflation expectations remain firmly anchored and that we do not prematurely signal an easing of our commitment to price stability.
